Business of Home is the leading business media brand for the home industry, delivering essential news, analysis and insights for interior designers and home furnishings professionals. Since launching in 2009, it has served as a trusted daily resource, with offerings that include a robust digital newsroom, newsletters, podcasts, a quarterly magazine, the industry’s largest job board, business workshops, and a membership community for the entrepreneurs, executives and creatives shaping the sector.

### [Best Buy and IGN Pair Up Ahead Of Major Game Releases](https://www.adweek.com/commerce/best-buy-and-ign-pair-up-ahead-of-major-game-releases/)


Adweek 10/20/2026


Best Buy has launched a new online portal called Best Buy Gamers, currently in beta. The portal will include reviews, articles, trailers, videos, and other exclusive content in partnership with IGN...“Gamers invest a lot of time and thought in their games and devices—from watching the latest gaming trailers to reading new reviews,” said Marty Senn, chief marketing officer at Best Buy, in a statement. “IGN has long been a go-to destination for gaming news, making them a natural partner as we launch Best Buy Gamers and build an experience that helps gamers stay connected to the games, trends and content they love.”

### [BabyCenter’s unveils most popular baby names for 2026](https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2026/10/20/babycenter-most-popular-baby-names-2026/92333110007/)


USA Today 10/20/2026


Noah and Olivia remain the most popular baby names, according to BabyCenter's 2026 ranking and data, which also highlights other trendy names influenced by hockey TV shows, Greek epics, and E-names...Steph Coffield, baby name advisor for BabyCenter, said in a statement that the most surprising name trend this year was "Eliana’s meteoric rise to become the second most popular name for girls," adding that if its momentum continues, it may become the top name next year, dethroning Olivia.
